description: Get the live component tree from a connected React Native app. Call get_runtime_status first to verify connection. Returns the full hierarchy as currently rendered, including component types and parent-child relationships.

includeNative.description: Include native/host components like View, Text. Default: true

maxDepth.description: Maximum depth to return. Default: unlimited

rootComponent.description: Filter to a specific root component by display name

name: get_live_tree
